steps.name: If Domain Controller: Set 'Enforce password history' to '24 or more password(s)' via Active Directory cmdlets…
steps.function: 2. If Domain Controller: Set 'Enforce password history' to '24 or more password(s)' via Active Directory cmdlets (Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy) or Group Policy. Do NOT use community.windows.win_security_policy on DC — use AD/GPO cmdlets.

steps.name: If Member Server: Set 'Enforce password history' to '24 or more password(s)'. Recommended module…
steps.function: 3. If Member Server: Set 'Enforce password history' to '24 or more password(s)'. Recommended module: community.windows.win_security_policy with section=System Access and the key name. Do NOT use raw secedit CLI — community.windows.win_security_policy handles secedit internally and avoids encoding / path issues.

compliance_constraints: This checkpoint applies to BOTH Domain Controllers (DomainRole 4/5) AND Member Servers (DomainRole 1-3). Detect the server role first using (Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole. DC branch: use Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy or GPO cmdlets. Member Server branch: use community.windows.win_security_policy with the appropriate section and key — do NOT use raw secedit CLI, community.windows.win_security_policy handles it internally. Both branches MUST end with a VERIFY step.
Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all steps complete and report status

If the remediation targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, SKIP all remediation steps. Do NOT install prerequisite packages.

This checkpoint applies to BOTH Domain Controllers (DomainRole 4/5) AND Member Servers (DomainRole 1-3). Detect the server role first using (Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole, then remediate via the correct path: DC → Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy or GPO cmdlets; Member Server → secedit /export → edit cfg → secedit /configure /areas SECURITYPOLICY. Do NOT use Set-ItemProperty for security policy — it has no effect. Both branches must end with a VERIFY step.
reference_procedure:
To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to 24 or more password(s):
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account
Policies\Password Policy\Enforce password history
